article: How to Use the Tab Auto Refresh Extension in Microsoft Edge
scope: Compared the full Japanese article and twelve translations, store link and current listing name, installation flow, screenshot age, permission language, site access, metadata, and link quality.
findings: Removed the duplicate future date and retained the original 2024-04-06 date; set lastmod to 2026-11-24.
Updated installation button guidance to the current Microsoft Edge Add-ons “Get” flow and added a permission review before adding.
Added localized guidance to limit extension access to necessary sites or on-click use and avoid repeated reloads where they can cause unintended effects.
Clarified that screenshots are from 2024 and the current interface may differ; preserved the store listing link, which remains live.
